events.title: Uncosy will be in Steam Next Fest!

events.title: Update v0.58.3 Shinies!
events.summary: Hey everyone!I'm very excited about this update, I've been working hard on it in preparation for Next Fest and it's got some of the features that I've always wanted but never quite had time for. This will likely be the final content update for release, I hope you enjoy it!NewShinies: Added new, extremely rare, golden plushies. events.title: Update v0.54.0 Floor Décor
events.summary: FeaturesFloor Décor: Added two new décor slots in the corners of the room with several new decoration itemsBugfixescreatures in the machine are now randomized based on your runs seedthe radio no longer plays over the end creditskeeper is now audible in the roomfixed a change to rng that made the same song play all the time

events.title: Update v0.54.0 Bench Décor
events.summary: FeaturesBench Décor: Added a room slot on the bench next to the PC.

events.title: Update v0.53.0 Room decoration
events.summary: FeaturesPC: There is a new "ROOM" app on the PC that will let you unlock décor for The Room.Wall Décor: There are 8 slots to place wall hangings, in this version I have included some posters and neon signs. More to come!Display Shelf: There is an expandable display shelf which you can place your favourite plushies on for safe keeping.

events.title: Update v0.51.1 Achievements!
events.summary: AchievementsYou will now earn achievements as you progress through the game.You can view your completed and pending achievements, including your progress toward them from the PC in the new achievements app.Any progress you make in the demo will come into the full game on release, including completed achievements.

events.title: Update 0.36.1: Demo fixes
events.summary: Hi everyone, first of all thanks to everyone who's played the demo and given feedback. I'm really glad that everyone seems to be enjoying the game. This is officially my first steam patch! I hope these and future changes continue to improve your experience with the game. Playing on a controllerImproved skill tree navigation. When navigating between nodes on the tree with keyboard or controller navigation is now easier and more predictable.Selected upgrades stop hanging off the edge of the screen
